g.text: Sent when the status changes (model, effort, context, usage, branch, lines changed and the
rest), and every 30 seconds while nothing changes. Never twice within 2 seconds.
a new token, or leave empty
Kept in the keychain on macOS, in an owner-only file elsewhere; never shown.
Edit this file to change what is sent. It is JSON; a value written as "{{name}}" is replaced
by that variable. Each send reads the file anew.
Times: now, the 5-hour reset and the weekly reset
Sent as ISO 8601 text in UTC, such as "2026-10-06T09:58:23.602Z".
Sent as Unix time, a number of seconds, such as 1791280703. Claude Code gives a status
line script its reset times in this format.
Sent as Unix time, a number of milliseconds, such as 1791280703602. {{timestamp}} is the
